# Joints and Degrees of Freedom

Model: MyoHand fragment, MyoSim `93b0ca8f4ec90c9899ee7f05fee561e9911da91b`, MuJoCo 3.17.0.

All joints are hinges. Values are stored in radians; degrees are for display only. The BioHand neutral pose is `model.qpos0` (all zeros, inside every range). This is the model's zero, **not** an anatomically defined neutral position.

Positive direction is *derived from the model* (kinematic perturbation and muscle moment-arm signs, both verified by `tests/test_p2_anatomy.py`), at qpos0 only. Hinge rotation sense is constant over the range; muscle moment-arm signs over the range are P4.

**BioHand range** is the range of the BioHand reference model = upstream + patches wrist_rom_v1, muscle_fixes_v1, limit_stiffness_v1, thumb_intrinsics_v1, passive_stiffness_v1 (`data/patches/`). Upstream files are never modified.

## Notes per joint

- `pro_sup_r`: kinematic: radial axis rotates negatively about the distal axis (pronation for a right forearm); muscle: PT and PQ drive +
- `deviation_r`: kinematic: fingertip moves radially; muscle: ECRL drives +, ECU and FCU drive -. P3: SIGN INVERTED relative to the MoBL-ARMS source (reports/P3/wrist_convention_check.json, fingertip-direction cosine -0.99): in MoBL, + is ulnar, so its range -10..+25 deg means 10 deg radial / 25 deg ulnar. MyoHand kept the numbers, so it allows 25 deg radial / 10 deg ulnar (gap T10). Wrist mechanism also differs (single joint vs two-row splines, gap T6). BioHand patch wrist_rom_v1 restores the source meaning: range -25..+10 deg (25 deg ulnar / 10 deg radial) in MyoHand's sign convention.
- `flexion_r`: kinematic: fingertip moves palmar; muscle: FCR, FCU, PL drive +, ECRB, ECU, EDC drive -. P3: direction matches MoBL-ARMS (cosine 0.9996); range narrowed from +/-70 deg (gap T5); BioHand patch wrist_rom_v1 restores +/-70 deg
- `cmc_flexion_r`: oblique axis defined by MoBL/2nd-Hand; thumb CMC conventions vary - do not relabel without a source
- `mp_flexion_r`: range -45..+40 deg = 45 deg flexion, 40 deg extension
- `ip_flexion_r`: range -75..+25 deg = 75 deg flexion, 25 deg extension
- `mcp2_flexion_r`: range 0..90 deg: no hyperextension
- `mcp2_abduction_r`: anatomically abduction for digit II; RI2 drives +, UI_UB2 drives -
- `mcp3_flexion_r`: range 0..90 deg: no hyperextension
- `mcp3_abduction_r`: radial abduction of digit III; RI3 drives +, UI_UB3 drives -
- `mcp4_flexion_r`: range 0..90 deg: no hyperextension
- `mcp4_abduction_r`: anatomically adduction for digit IV (abduction is defined relative to digit III); RI4 drives +, UI_UB4 drives -
- `mcp5_flexion_r`: range 0..90 deg: no hyperextension
- `mcp5_abduction_r`: anatomically adduction for digit V (abduction is defined relative to digit III); RI5 drives +, UI_UB5 drives -
